title: 第12章 不是盗窃！是报仇！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
此刻的厉行天已经顺利的将千年骨玉炼化。

    重新感受到体内经脉流转自如，他也重重的叹了一口气。

    总感觉有点不太容易，怎么重生了还不如上辈子顺利的感觉。

    至于师姐的话，厉行天也不在意，自己行不行，他自己还不知道吗？

    这也倒不是说新拜的师父不好，厉行天也经历过大风大浪，也见过许许多多，形形色色的人，他能感觉到自家师父还是真心关心自己的。

    尤其是那一本修炼功法，那种级别的功法，哪怕是在中州也能掀起巨大浪潮。

    他缓缓站起身，伸展了一下身子，随后就看见自己师父热切的眼神。

    厉行天心里有些不安道：“师父，怎……怎么了？”

    楚星尘先外放神识，确定了李应灵已经不在周围，倒不是不能让李应灵听见，只是这丫头要是知道厉行天是重生者的话。

    指不定要倒腾什么幺蛾子事情，现在还是以稳为主。

    楚星尘脸上露出一丝笑容，语气热切：

    “徒弟啊，你上辈子应该有不少奇遇吧？”

    “是……是有一些。”

    “那我们附近可有什么秘境，亦或者天材地宝之类的？”

    厉行天听见这话，大大的松了口气，这些都算小问题。

    “我们附近的秘境早就被附近大小宗门清理的干干净净了，至于奇遇……”

    仔细回想，随后厉行天摇了摇头道：“真正奇遇还得是到中州之后才能遇见，毕竟那边才是天下灵脉汇聚之地。”

    “那就没有一点能赚灵石的地方？！”

    “师父，你缺灵石了？”

    也没隐藏什么，楚星尘果断回答道：

    “打算建个聚灵阵法，缺点灵石买点材料。”

    厉行天闻言，微微思索了会：“如果师父信我，清风宗的矿场上能捞到不少灵石。”

    “我在那里挖过三年灵石，知晓矿场如何运作，里面只有一位金丹坐镇。”

    “要师父有把握，或许有利可图。”

    楚星尘没有着急答应，只是目光看了看厉行天。

    觉察师父目光，厉行天拱手道：“我绝无有替自己报仇的意思。”

    “不……”楚星尘摇了摇头道，“记住我们这回不是为了灵石，而是为了替你报仇。”

    “顺便替被清风宗迫害的广大群众伸张正义。”

    楚星尘表情严肃，语气认真道：“作为天道盟的弟子，你的眼界不能如此狭窄。”

    “啊？”厉行天有些呆愣的看向自己的师父。

    此刻的他也有些愣神，不知道是师父既要钱又要脸，还是单纯的想找个正大光明的理由。

    不过无论是哪种，听师父说话，应该都没有怀疑自己。
content_en:
At this moment, Li Xingtian has successfully refined the thousand-year bone jade.

Feeling the meridians flowing freely in his body again, he sighed heavily.

It always feels a bit not easy, why is my rebirth not as smooth as my previous life?

As for the senior sister, Li Xingtian doesn't care. Doesn't he know whether he can do it or not?

This is not to say that his new master is not good. Li Xingtian has also experienced great storms and met many different kinds of people. He can feel that his master still really cares about him.

Especially that one cultivation technique, that level of technique can set off a huge wave even in Zhongzhou.

He stood up slowly, stretched his body, and then saw his master's eager eyes.

Li Xingtian felt a little uneasy and said, "Master, what...what happened?"

Chu Xingchen first released his consciousness to confirm that Li Yingling was no longer around. It wasn't that Li Yingling couldn't hear her, but if this girl knew that Li Xingtian was a reborn person.

Maybe there will be some trouble, but for now we still focus on stability.

A smile appeared on Chu Xingchen's face, and his tone was eager:

"Apprentice, you must have had many adventures in your previous life, right?"

"Yes... there are some."

"Then are there any secret realms or treasures near us?"

Li Xingtian breathed a sigh of relief when he heard this. These were minor problems.

"The secret realm near us has long been cleaned up by the nearby sects. As for the unexpected encounters..."

After thinking about it carefully, Li Xingtian shook his head and said: "The real adventure can only be encountered after arriving in Zhongzhou. After all, that is where the world's spiritual veins gather."

"Then there's no place to earn spiritual stones?!"

"Master, are you short of spiritual stones?"

Without hiding anything, Chu Xingchen replied decisively:

"I plan to build a spirit gathering formation. I need some spiritual stones to buy some materials."

Hearing this, Li Xingtian thought for a moment and said, "If Master believes in me, we can get a lot of spiritual stones from the Qingfeng Sect's mines."

"I have mined spiritual stones there for three years and know how the mine works. There is only one Jindan in charge."

"Master, if you are sure, it might be profitable."

Chu Xingchen did not agree in a hurry, but just looked at Li Xingtian.

Aware of his master's gaze, Li Xingtian cupped his hands and said, "I have no intention of avenging myself."

"No..." Chu Xingchen shook his head and said, "Remember, we are not here for the spirit stone this time, but to avenge you."

"By the way, we will seek justice for the broad masses of people who have been persecuted by the Qingfeng Sect."

Chu Xingchen's expression was serious and he said in a serious tone: "As a disciple of the Tiandao Alliance, your vision cannot be so narrow."

"Ah?" Li Xingtian looked at his master blankly.

At this moment, he was also a little dazed. He didn't know whether the master wanted both money and face, or whether he simply wanted to find an upright reason.

But no matter what it is, listening to Master's words, you should not doubt yourself.
